description: The Waldenburg ruin stands on the Rehag rock ridge about 170 metres above the small town, with substantial medieval masonry of the Frohburg castle burned in 1798. The walls are a ruin, not a restored palace, and the town roofs sit in the valley of the Vordere Frenke. Reigoldswil was not used. The Open-Meteo model is fully overcast and mild for the ridge, with no rain.
